characters.summary: James Rhodes wears heavily armored, military-grade exoskeleton suits equipped with ballistic weaponry, micro-missiles, and shoulder-mounted cannons. He engages foes at medium to long range using superior firepower and flight.
weaknesses: Internal systems vulnerable to direct hacking or EMP disruption
Mechanical joints can be jammed or disabled with sufficient physical force
limitations: Requires suit maintenance and power replenishment
Reduced mobility when heavy systems are damaged

sources.supports: General overview of War Machine's armor, capabilities, and equipment in the MCU.

feats.claim: Fired shoulder-mounted weaponry and minigun during the battle at Avengers Facility and airport skirmish.

notableResults.note: Struck by an accidental energy beam from Vision during the airport battle, causing a severe fall.

campaignTags.claim: Armor includes integrated jet thrusters allowing flight.
Utilizes advanced weapons systems and missiles mounted on the suit.
Experienced United States Air Force pilot.

unknowns: Exact reactor output and top flight speed under maximum payload.

characters.summary: James Rhodes operates a patriotic red, white, and blue variant of the War Machine armor commissioned by the US government. It fights with identical military ordnance and flight capabilities to standard War Machine.
weaknesses: Remote override vulnerability exploited by Eric Savin/Aldrich Killian
limitations: Prone to remote security overrides if government control protocols are compromised
characters.formDifferences: Features a red, white, and blue paint scheme commissioned for public relations, with identical underlying combat functions to the War Machine armor.

sources.supports: Details on the Iron Patriot armor worn by James Rhodes in Iron Man 3.

feats.claim: Patrolled international airspace and confronted terrorists while wearing the Iron Patriot suit.

notableResults.note: Ambushed and captured after the suit's remote systems were locked out.

campaignTags.claim: Wears the Iron Patriot armored suit.
Armor is capable of flight via jet systems.

unknowns: Whether any internal weapon loadout differed significantly from standard War Machine marks.

characters.summary: Bucky Barnes is a brainwashed super-soldier equipped with a vibranium-enhanced bionic left arm and extensive training in covert ops, firearms, and hand-to-hand combat.

mechanisms: Vibranium bionic arm blocks incoming strikes and bullets

weaknesses: Prone to psychological triggers and activation words that control his behavior
limitations: Human endurance limits outside of super-soldier conditioning

sources.supports: Details on Bucky Barnes as the Winter Soldier, his bionic arm, and super-soldier abilities.

feats.claim: Halted a moving vehicle with his bare cybernetic arm during an ambush.

notableResults.note: Fought evenly on the highway before identities were revealed.

campaignTags.claim: Trained elite assassin specializing in covert operations and infiltration.

unknowns: Full durability limits of the original non-vibranium hydra bionic arm versus the Wakandan upgrade.

characters.summary: Bucky Barnes briefly wields Captain America's vibranium shield alongside his super-soldier abilities and tactical expertise.
weaknesses: Lacks the decades of specialized shield mastery possessed by Steve Rogers
limitations: Shield reliance leaves flanks open if thrown incorrectly
characters.formDifferences: Utilizes Captain America's vibranium shield for defensive blocking and ricochet attacks.

sources.supports: References to Bucky using Cap's shield in combat.

feats.claim: Caught and threw Captain America's shield during the airport battle.

notableResults.note: Assisted by Steve Rogers in subduing Tony Stark.

campaignTags.claim: Retains cybernetic bionic arm while operating.

unknowns: Whether Bucky's psychological programming was fully dormant during this period.

characters.summary: Free of Hydra programming, Bucky Barnes operates as the White Wolf in Wakanda, utilizing an advanced Wakandan vibranium bionic arm and specialized local weaponry.

mechanisms: Wakandan vibranium armor and bionic arm shock absorption

limitations: Relies on standard infantry gear outside of his prosthesis
characters.formDifferences: Replaces the Hydra-designed arm with an advanced Wakandan vibranium prosthetic and sheds all psychological triggers.

sources.supports: Details on Bucky's tenure as the White Wolf in Wakanda.

feats.claim: Fought off Outrider hordes during the Battle of Wakanda using standard rifles and his vibranium arm.

campaignTags.claim: Equipped with advanced Wakandan vibranium cybernetic arm.

unknowns: Full capabilities of the Wakandan arm beyond standard kinetic absorption.

characters.summary: Logan infused with demonic hellfire powers, combining his adamantium claws and healing factor with supernatural flame attacks.
weaknesses: Holy magic or mystical wards capable of repelling demonic entities
limitations: Demonic influence can cloud tactical judgment
characters.formDifferences: Gains demonic hellfire generation, flaming skeletal aura, and enhanced magical offense.

notableResults.note: Overpowered demonic adversaries using hellfire claws.

characters.summary: An aged, battle-weary Logan whose healing factor is severely impaired by systemic adamantium poisoning, relying on decades of combat experience and hidden claws.
weaknesses: Slow healing rate leaves him vulnerable to lasting physical trauma and exhaustion
limitations: Exhausts quickly in extended engagements due to organ strain
characters.formDifferences: Physical aging and adamantium toxicity severely weaken his healing factor, stamina, and overall vitality.

sources.supports: Details on the aged, declining Wolverine in the film Logan.

feats.claim: Survived multiple gunshot wounds and stab injuries despite slow recovery times.

notableResults.note: Defeated armed mercenaries in close combat despite heavy injuries.

campaignTags.claim: Possesses a heavily slowed mutant healing factor due to old age and poison.

unknowns: Whether his claws still pop reliably under extreme systemic fatigue.
